meaning: For any selected candidate, global well-founded actual-concrete grounding implies well-founded grounding on its complete actual ancestry cone, and global contingent concrete dependence implies contingent dependence within that cone. These scope implications, together with the combined local-but-not-global model, certify a strict weakening of both premises. They do not establish any instance of either local or global metaphysical premise.
